item.title: Man City agree £125m fee for Chelsea's Fernandez
item.description: Manchester City agree to pay a British transfer record fee of £125m for Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez.

item.title: Newcastle sign Fernandez-Pardo from Lille for £51m
item.description: Newcastle United sign Belgium forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo from Lille for an initial £51.4m.

item.title: Valencia sign Liverpool's Elliott on loan
item.description: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott joins Valencia on a season-long loan

item.title: Celtic sign Parma's Sorensen, with more to come before deadline
item.description: Celtic sign Parma midfielder Oliver Sorensen on loan shortly after assistant manager Shaun Maloney suggests the Scottish champions were working on up to four additions before finalising their Europa League squad on Wednesday.

item.title: Aston Villa sign Mbaye and Harwood-Bellis
item.description: Aston Villa complete the signings of Senegal winger Ibrahim Mbaye from Paris St-Germain and English centre-back Taylor Harwood-Bellis from Southampton.

item.title: Juventus sign Sarr on loan and agree Woltemade loan
item.description: Juventus announce the signing of midfielder Pape Matar Sarr from Tottenham on an initial loan while also agree a loan deal for Newcastle forward Nick Woltemade.

item.title: Palace and Sunderland battling for £30m Fofana
item.description: Crystal Palace attempt to hijack Sunderland's move for Lyon's Malick Fofana.

item.title: McTominay to miss Scotland games with minor heart issue
item.description: Scotland midfielder Scott McTominay is to have a minor heart procedure after the discovery of "a mild benign arrhythmia", Napoli have announced.

item.title: Barcelona complete signing of Arsenal striker Jesus
item.description: Barcelona have completed the signing of Gabriel Jesus on a permanent deal.

item.title: Ahanor announced by two clubs in one day after Chelsea workaround
item.description: Chelsea announce teenage defender Honest Ahanor will join the club in 2027 after the Atalanta player has completed a loan at Crystal Palace.

item.title: Every done deal on transfer deadline day
item.description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

item.title: Fulham agree to sign midfielders Angel and Larsson

item.title: Man Utd locked in talks for Leicester midfielder Page

item.title: Brighton agree £15m deal for Millwall winger Azeez
item.description: Brighton agree a deal to sign 25-year-old Nigeria winger Femi Azeez from Championship club Millwall.

item.title: Everton agree to re-sign Grealish on loan from Man City

item.title: The summer signings already making an impact - Sangare, Rogers, Enciso

item.title: Saka earns Arsenal hard-fought win at Aston Villa

item.title: Lamine Yamal and Raphinha score twice as Barcelona hit five

item.title: MOTD pundits debate controversial own goal in Man Utd victory

item.title: Given credits Farke's second-half tactical shift in Brentford draw
